countries.name: Canada
countries.description: Canada is one of the world's top study destinations, known for its high-quality education, diverse culture, and excellent post-study work opportunities. With world-class universities, affordable tuition, and a welcoming environment, Canada offers international students a pathway to global careers.

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.description: The United Kingdom is home to some of the world's oldest and most prestigious universities. With a rich academic tradition, diverse culture, and globally recognized degrees, the UK offers international students an unparalleled educational experience and strong career prospects.
